dct_title_s: Iran (Islamic Republic of) - Earthquake on Jul 19 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000qdwb](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000qdwb) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Jul 19 2025 11km SE of Aliabad-E Katul. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 36.8444 longitude 54.9395. It impacted 513788 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
